data.name: Hunter's Mark Demo
data.detailed_description:
Hunter's Mark takes place within a world of fantasy magic and creatures mixed with modern mechanisms. You play as a Hunter and your job is to cull down populations of Goblins, Ghouls and whatever else the Guild wants Gone. And with your impressive stamina, sharp senses, and a Guild-funded arsenal of fantasy-esque guns (ammo not included) at your disposal, you're an expert at it.

Happy hunting.

FEATURES

  • First-Person Hunting

    Pick and prepare for missions of FPS-Action, Run, Jump, Crouch and Dash around the level, around enemies, perhaps even Dash INTO enemies. Gun down enemy hordes until your quota is met, and once it is, head back home to a paycheck. Repeat ad nauseam.

  • Weapons

    Fantasy-esque troubles need fantasy-esque weaponry to deal with, luckily you have a few given to you by the Guild. You'll be able to bring Three different weapons on missions, but you'll have to fund your own ammunition, right out of your own wallet. Joy.

  • Stealth Is An Option

    While you can always throw caution to the wind and dump all your ammo on enemies, you could also pick them off one-by-one with extra damage from Sneak Attacks and preserve your ammo. Be careful however, because one poorly thought out shot and you could get forced to use the former option.

data.short_description: Hunter's Mark is a bloody Mission-based First-Person Shooter taking place within a fantasy world filled with ghoulish creatures in need of culling. The Guild needs the strongest and most cunning Hunters for the job, which is where you come in.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 12th Gen Intel(R) Core (TM) i7-12700 (2.10 GHz)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
